name: vLLM 0.1.4 (upstream CUDA) on nvidia-l40s: LLaMA2-7B single L40 offline throughput tok/s
unit: tok/s aggregate (offline inference, 1000 questions; NOT per-request)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (EmbeddedLLM blog 'vllm_rocm', Oct 27 2023). LLaMA2-7B single L40. vLLM v0.1.4 upstream CUDA build; offline throughput benchmark over 1000 questions - aggregate tokens/sec for the whole run. Requests/min companion column corroborates ordering. Batch is the full 1000-question sweep, not a fixed concurrency.
notes: Early vLLM 0.1.4 era - pre-continuous-batching maturity, so a LOWER bound vs modern vLLM. MI210 parity claim is vs A100-80GB on identical workload.
